subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula is located on the far left of the secluded Horseback Archery area.

evidence.quote: If it's still night, head to the far left of this area and you'll find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 090 out of 100)

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Scoring 1000 points in Horseback Archery awards a Piece of Heart, with pots worth 100 points, target outer rims worth 30, inner rims worth 60, and center targets worth 100.

evidence.quote: The first goal here is to acquire 1000 points. Easy enough. The pots are worth 100 points, the outer rim of the targets are 30, inner rim is 60, and the very center is 100. Obviously you should hit the pots and the center of the targets. If you successfully get 1000 points, you'll get a Piece of Heart. (HEART PIECES: 35 out of 36)

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Scoring 1500 points in the Horseback Archery minigame rewards the Biggest Quiver, allowing Link to carry 50 arrows.

evidence.quote: the Gerudo offers you another challenge: to get 1500 points....the Gerudo by giving you the BIGGEST QUIVER, which allows you to carry 50 Arrows.

subject: River of Sand
text: To cross the River of Sand in the Haunted Wasteland, hop onto the front crate and Longshot to a crate across the river.

evidence.quote: Simply hop onto the crate ahead and Longshot one of the other crates across the River to cross.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found inside the secret shrine along the flag route in the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: Anyway, inside are two torches and a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 091 out of 100)

subject: Secret shrine
text: Lighting the two torches inside the Haunted Wasteland secret shrine with Fire Arrows makes a chest appear containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: After getting the spider, light the two torches with Fire Arrows to make a chest appear. Open it for a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Poe guide
text: Climbing to the top of the secret shrine and using the Lens of Truth reveals a Poe guide to follow through the desert to the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote: Crawl back out and climb up to the top and put on the Lens of Truth to find the Poe guide the Gerudo was talking about. Follow this Poe, keeping the Lens of Truth on, until you finally reach a huge monument, called the Desert Colossus.

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Bombing the cracked wall between two palm trees to the right of the Desert Colossus opens a Great Fairy Fountain where the Great Fairy grants Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: Bomb the cracked wall between those trees and head inside to find another Great Fairy Fountain. You know what to do to summon her. This time she'll give you NAYRU'S LOVE, which protects you from any damage for a few minutes.

subject: Empty grove
text: Playing the Song of Storms on the flat rock at the empty grove south of the Desert Colossus fills the grove with water and creates a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote: At this empty grove, play the Song of Storms on the flat rock to fill the grove, creating a Fairy Fountain.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on a palm tree at the oasis grove in Desert Colossus at night.

evidence.quote: At this same place, at night, a Gold Skulltula is on a nearby palm tree. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 092 out of 100)

subject: Sheik
text: Sheik appears outside the Spirit Temple at the Desert Colossus and teaches the Requiem of Spirit.

evidence.quote: Hey, good ole' Sheik appeared. He tells you a few things, then teaches you the REQUIEM OF SPIRIT.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping a Bottle of Bugs into the soft dirt patch outside the Spirit Temple as Young Link uncovers a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Back here, as Young Link, drop a Bottle of Bugs onto the plot of dirt (no need to recapture any bugs) to make a Gold Skulltula pop out. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 093 out of 100)

subject: Armos
text: To defeat the Armos surrounded by a spike trap, plant a bomb near it and touch the Armos to awaken it before the bomb detonates.

evidence.quote: kill the Armos being surrounded by a spike trap. (Plant a bomb by it, then touch the Armos to wake it before the bomb explodes and it'll be gone.)

subject: Crystal switch chest
text: Hitting the crystal switch behind the gate with the Boomerang lowers the gate to reveal a chest containing a Blue Rupee or a replacement Deku Shield.

evidence.quote: Now, use the Boomerang to hit the crystal switch behind the gate. Hitting it will lower the gate, creating a bridge. Open the chest across the bridge for a BLUE RUPEE. (A Deku Shield if you lost your current one....it seems the chests with Blue Rupees contain something you lost.)

subject: Anubis
text: Anubis mimics Link's movements like a mirror and is defeated by hitting a crystal switch to raise fire and positioning across from the fire trap.

evidence.quote: In here you'll encounter a puzzle dealing with an annoying enemy, Anubis. This enemy always mimics your position like a mirror. Its only weakness is fire....If you hit the crystal switch to your right, you'll see some fire rise up. Well, that's where you need Anubis to go. Just move to the opposite platform of the fire and Anubis will move to act like your mirror.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: Collecting five Silver Rupees in the Wallmaster room opens the gate.

evidence.quote: Now, you have to collect five Silver Rupees to open the gate. Two are at the top and you must climb for them, two are at the foot of the gate, and one is behind the torch.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located past the lowered gate in the Wallmaster room.

evidence.quote: Cross the now lowered gate, and kill the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 094 out of 100)

subject: Torch puzzle chest
text: Lighting the two unlit torches using a Deku Stick from the lit torch behind the gate causes a chest containing a Small Key to drop onto the carpet.

evidence.quote: Now, take a Deku Stick and light it with the lit torch behind the gate, and go to the two unlit ones and light them. This will make a chest fall onto the carpet. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found high on the wall behind Link after climbing the ridges in the enclosed room.

evidence.quote: You're now in an enclosed room with ridges to climb up. Kill the Skullwalltulas first before climbing it. At the top, turn around and kill the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 095 out of 100)

subject: Boomerang crystal switch chest
text: Hitting the crystal switch with the Boomerang in the room with Lizalfos spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote: Alright, in this room, kill the Skullwalltulas and two Lizalfos, then hit the crystal switch with the Boomerang to make a chest appear. Open it for some BOMBCHUS.

subject: Sun face
text: Sending a Bombchu to detonate the rock with light peering through allows sunlight to illuminate the sun face on the floor and unlock the door.

evidence.quote: Plant a Bombchu and have it scurry over to the rock that has light peering out of it, and it'll blow it up. This'll make the light cover the sun face on the ground, thus activating it and opening the door.

subject: Large treasure chest
text: Casting Din's Fire while standing between the unlit torches on the platform makes a large chest containing the Dungeon Map appear.

evidence.quote: Stand on the platform between them, and use Din's Fire. A large treasure chest will appear in front of you, so open it to get the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Torch puzzle chest
text: Collecting the Silver Rupees at the top of the spiral staircase lights a torch, which can be used with a Deku Stick to light the unlit torches and spawn a Small Key chest.

evidence.quote: Once they're all collected, a torch will light. Get a Deku Stick out and light it with that torch, then start lighting all the unlit torches quickly. Doing so will make a chest containing a SMALL KEY appear.

subject: Sun face block
text: Pushing the block with the sun face into the light unlocks the next door.

evidence.quote: move the block with a sun face on its top over to the light to open the next door.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located above the doorway when turning around after entering the room past the sun block.

evidence.quote: Turn right around and look up to find another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 096 out of 100)

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Young Link can defeat the Iron Knuckle mini-boss by throwing bombs at him or by using Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: I think it would be wise to use Nayru's Love right about now....though you can just throw bombs at him if you have enough.

subject: Treasure chest outside
text: Opening the treasure chest outside on the Colossus statue after defeating the Iron Knuckle grants the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Anyway, open the treasure chest next to you to get the SILVER GAUNTLETS.

subject: Arch
text: Riding the Magic Plant as Adult Link allows Link to collect the Piece of Heart resting on the stone arch.

evidence.quote: Before entering, ride the Magic Plant, as there's a Piece of Heart on the arch, and a Gold Skulltula on a big rock. (HEART PIECES: 36 out of 36)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Riding the Magic Plant at night allows Adult Link to reach a Gold Skulltula on a large rock.

evidence.quote: ride the Magic Plant, as there's a Piece of Heart on the arch, and a Gold Skulltula on a big rock....Also, the game must be nighttime to make the Skulltula appear.

subject: Triforce chest
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem in the left room spawns a large chest reachable with the Longshot that contains the Compass.

evidence.quote: Next, stand on the Triforce emblem, play Zelda's Lullaby, Longshot to the large chest that appears, and open it for the COMPASS.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the blue block moves it to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time in front of the blue block to move it, revealing another Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 098 out of 100)

subject: Like Like room chest
text: Defeating the falling Like Like reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: A Like Like falls down and attempts to swallow you. Kill it before it takes your stuff. After it's dead, open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Sun face structure
text: Rotating the central mirror structure toward the sun faces reveals the exit door, drops chests containing a Recovery Heart or a freeze trap, and triggers a Wallmaster.

evidence.quote: move the central structure to each sun face. One of them opens the next door, make sure to find that. Two sun faces drop chests. One has a RECOVERY HEART and another freezes you when you open it. The other summons a Wallmaster.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song across from the staircase lets Link Longshot to Pierre and destroy a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: turn right and play your Scarecrow's Song. Longshot across, and kill the Gold Skulltula here. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 099 out of 100)

subject: Statue hand chest
text: Hovering to the colossus statue's hand and playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark summons a chest with a Small Key reachable with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: use the Hover Boots to get onto the statue's hand, and play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce mark. Longshot to the chest that appeared and open it for a SMALL KEY.
